question: What arose within the unmanifest sphere through the families, O greatly compassionate one?
premises: Something pertains to the unmanifest sphere
It was born through the families
inference: The families gave rise to what belongs to the unmanifest sphere
uncertainties: The exact subject of jātam is implicit
plain_english: O greatly compassionate one, by that means what belongs to the unmanifest sphere was born through the families.
